title: Nourishing Your Spirit Man: From Carnal to Spiritual
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner challenges listeners to evaluate their personal prayer life and asks the tough question: are we feeding our spirit man enough? As we explore 1 Corinthians chapter 3, Pastor Chris reminds us that spiritual growth requires consistent nourishment, and he offers practical advice on how to cultivate a deeper relationship with God. Join Pastor Chris as he encourages us to take our spiritual growth to the next level and live the life God has called us to.
